purpose: Datasheet-level candidate peripheral contracts. These do not assign MCU pins or prove board routing.

evidence_policy.datasheet_fact: May describe the identified component family independent of this PCB.
evidence_policy.board_connection: Must remain unknown until continuity, logic capture, schematic-quality tracing, or equivalent direct evidence exists.
evidence_policy.synthetic_test: Exercises generic component semantics only and must never be cited as rev010 wiring evidence.

candidates.observed: STLED316S-family marking visible in supplied photo

datasheet_contract.display: up to 6 digits / 8 segments plus discrete LED digit
datasheet_contract.keyscan: 8 x 2 matrix, two key bytes, SEG1/KS1 at LSB through SEG8/KS8 at MSB
datasheet_contract.irq: asserted low on key-buffer change; cleared after complete key-buffer read

evidence_needed: Trace CLK, STB, DIN/DOUT and IRQ_N nets to ATmega328 pins
Capture idle/boot traffic from original firmware without driving the bus
Identify which panel LEDs/digits and switches occupy each STLED memory/key position

candidates.observed: HC165AG marking visible at IC1 in supplied photo
evidence_needed: Trace PL, CP, CE, DS and Q7/Q7-bar nets
Observe original-firmware load/clock bursts if safely measurable
Trace S0-S2 and E to MCU or other logic
Trace Z to an ADC/support node
Measure settled ADC values and required acquisition delay after channel changes

gate output driver and active level
